description: An expander for Quad Algorithmic Rhythm, placed immediately to its right, that fits a run of steps into the time of a different number of steps, as a triplet does.

params.text: Applies this irrational rhythm to that track of the Quad Algorithmic Rhythm; unlit, the track is left alone.
Turns the irrational rhythm on and off; off leaves the track's timing as the rhythm generator made it.
Sets the step the run begins on, 1 to 71.
Scales the voltage at the starting step input, -100% to +100%.
Sets how many steps the run is made of, 2 to 72.
Scales the voltage at the number of steps input, -100% to +100%.
Sets how many of the track's steps the run is squeezed into, so 3 steps into 2 is a triplet. Turned below 1 it picks an irrational figure: root 2, root 3, the golden ratio, root 5, root 7, e or pi.
Scales the voltage at the ratio input, -100% to +100%.
Switches the starting position from counting steps to counting beats, so the run begins on the chosen beat whichever step that falls on.

inputs.text: A trigger turns the irrational rhythm on, and a second trigger turns it off.
Voltage moves the step the run begins on, 0.6 steps per volt at full attenuverter.
Voltage adds to the number of steps in the run, one step for every 1.8V at full attenuverter.
Voltage changes the figure the run is squeezed into, one count for every 1.8V at full attenuverter.

notes: Several of these can be chained, and one further to the right takes priority over one to its left, which is how a track carries more than one irrational run.

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
